a.lede: As parents look for alternatives to unrestricted smartphones, a growing number of companies are building phones designed specifically for kids, from feature-limited mobile devices to minimalist home phones.
a.title: Parents want safer phones for kids. These companies are answering the call.

b.lede: As flagship smartphones balloon in size, the Enough Phone offers a 5.3-inch handset. Choose between stock Android or an anti-distraction operating system.
b.title: Small Phones Have Vanished. Enough Phone Wants to Bring Them Back
